name: China Television Media, Ltd.
summary: China Television Media, Ltd. engages in the film and television (TV) program production and sales business in China. The company is involved in the planning, investment, production, operation, and management of ultra-high-definition/high-definition documentaries, TV programs, large-scale gala events, and promotional videos; pre-production and post-production technical services for film and television, as well as professional equipment rental services; and distribution and sales of film and television works. It also provides advertising services; and tourist ticket sales, park operations, and film and television shooting services. In addition, the company engages in investing in niche sectors…
